name: ASYMMETRIC_WEIGHTED_MAX_MIN
description: Replaced the polynomial with a max/min-based cross-evaluation that evaluates to equality if and only if x=y. Because the difference S_u - S_w retains the variables u and w (unlike the seed where they algebraically cancel out), models relying on the heuristic "u, w cancel out" will fail to recognize the universal x=y rule and likely assume the forbidden pairs vary per edge.
